findings.body:
chunk 1/2:

A fresh clone's documented `uv sync && uv run pytest` still collects the starter's API tests. The root `pytest.ini` (lines 1–5) takes precedence over this new table, and pytest does not merge configuration files ([pytest documentation](https://docs.pytest.org/en/stable/reference/customize.html)). Consequently, collection imports the new starter `conftest.py`, whose `httpx` dependency is absent from Forge's dependencies, and fails before running tests. The clone regression test misses this because its fixture omits `pytest.ini`. Put the collection restriction in the active configuration and preserve that configuration in the fixture.
